name: mirage
text: Thank you, I'll do it. First v1.0.57 is building: its error will list your Kalshi cash per shard, so I can see which shard holds the $6.29 and which one football bets trade on. Then I'll build the move (inside your own Kalshi account only, and only the amount an order needs, never a withdrawal) and tell you before it runs the first time.
